frame.ground_basis: ChassisV10.STEP holds the frame only (112 tube solids, no wheels or ground plane). The flat ground plane that best puts the delivered front and rear inboard pickups on the STEP tubes (median distance 24.5 mm front, 42.1 mm rear) is CAD Y = -76 mm; per axle the best fits lie within 5 mm of their minimum from -95 to -68 mm (front) and -83 to -53 mm (rear). Static clearance at the frame's lowest point (CAD Y -26.5 mm) is 49.5 mm.

requirements_for_chassisv11.pickup_nodes: every inboard pickup, rocker pivot and spring mount on a node of at least four tubes (the modelled node: four 25.4 x 1.65 mm tubes to frame junctions within 400 mm, triangulated); the compliance results rest on it; Table 10 row 9 verifies by in-situ pull tests
requirements_for_chassisv11.actuation_nodes: the frame provides nodes at rocker_pivot and spring_inner as listed (196 mm front and 143 mm rear from the nearest ChassisV10 node)
requirements_for_chassisv11.caster: 3.656 deg, inherited from the delivered uprights and held for the limit cue (32% aligning-torque fall at the limit against 79% at 1 deg); Table 10 row 18 measures it
requirements_for_chassisv11.rod_ends: bolt axes along the kingpin at the upright (both ball joints and the tie-rod outer), along the A-arm pivot axis inboard and vertical at the rack; worst misalignment 4.4 deg over travel at lock; 5/16-24 shanks fail the friction-moment fatigue screen (open item)
requirements_for_chassisv11.links: front: 5/8 x 0.065 in lower-rear and 5/8 x 0.049 in lower-front legs, 3/4 x 0.083 in tie rod, 5/8 x 0.035 in elsewhere; rear: 5/8 x 0.065 in lower-front and 5/8 x 0.049 in lower-rear legs (margin: 5/8 x 0.035 in throughout would give link factor 2.89), 5/8 x 0.035 in elsewhere; 4130
requirements_for_chassisv11.brake_bias_front: 0.73 (balanced, 1.57 g); 0.60 is refused by the deceleration wall
requirements_for_chassisv11.rocker_bearings: 2 x SKF 6204-2RSH front (static factor 2.44) and 2 x SKF 6205-2RSH rear (2.08), 30 mm apart; hubs (bearing OD + 3 mm front, + 3.5 mm rear, 44 mm long) clear the ChassisV10 tubes by 23.1 mm front and 53.9 mm rear
requirements_for_chassisv11.damper: Ohlins TTX25 MkII FSAE (200 mm eye to eye extended, 57 mm stroke) at each corner: static eye to eye 176.8 mm front and 177.0 mm rear, 2.8 and 2.4 mm short of top-out at full droop, 14.2 and 13.8 mm of stroke left at full bump (40.0 and 40.8 mm used over +/-25 mm); springs 24.8 N/mm front (2.6 Hz) and 34.8 N/mm rear (3.0 Hz); the damper closes at 45.6 mm of bump front and 43.1 mm rear, so a bump stop engages at 35 to 40 mm. Springs: rear the Ohlins 200 lb/in (35.0 N/mm, 3.01 Hz); front 24.8 N/mm (142 lb/in), below the Ohlins range (150 to 650 lb/in), made to rate for the damper's spring seat; with the 150 lb/in catalogue spring the front runs at 2.68 Hz and about 12 Nm/deg less front bar keeps the roll-stiffness share
requirements_for_chassisv11.actuation: pushrod on the upright beside the lower ball joint (64 mm front, 47 mm rear), rocker and spring re-placed against the ChassisV10 tubes and the declared upright, hub, rim, link and (rear) drivetrain envelopes at ground CAD Y -76 mm, rocker axis free (tilt 14 deg front, 15 deg rear): motion ratio 0.804 front and 0.821 rear, spread 7.7% and 3.4%, swept clearance 9.5 mm front and 5.1 mm rear, surface to surface; V10 node reach not imposed
requirements_for_chassisv11.verification: Table 10 of the paper pre-registers the physical checks; they are tests of this brief, not open items
requirements_for_chassisv11.braking_compliance: front: |toe in the 1.5 g stop| <= 0.25 deg is a wall of the search; on the derived frame with the links in series the final front toes out 0.23 deg per wheel (0.185 deg of it the links), so a 60% left-right brake difference steers the axle 0.069 deg, inside the +/-0.08 deg toe band; it loses 1.02 deg of caster. The lower wishbone's base is 167 mm along its pivot axis. At the rear a 1.06 g launch toes each wheel in 0.164 deg and a traction and cornering exit 0.146 deg. Table 10 row 9 measures both
requirements_for_chassisv11.lower_fore_bracket: front lower-front bracket rated >= 17.5 kN (factor 2.0 on the final front's 8.7 kN in a curb strike while braking)
requirements_for_chassisv11.build_tolerance: jig-weld (+/-0.5 mm tabs): 100% predicted yield on both corners; hand-weld (+/-1.5 mm): 1193 of 2000 builds front (59.65%, KNIFE_EDGE) and 1865 of 2000 rear (93.25%, TEMPERED), so the frame is jig-welded
requirements_for_chassisv11.rack_stop: rack end stops at 26.8 mm of rack, where the axle's mean steer reaches 25.6 deg (118.9 deg of wheel); the clearance sweep runs to 27.0 mm
requirements_for_chassisv11.frame_twist: rack tie-rod inner and each wishbone's inner pickups co-located on one triangulated bay; twist toe at 2000 Nm/deg is 0.013 deg steady (52 Nm) and 0.15 deg at the 618 Nm bound; Table 10 row 12 measures it
requirements_for_chassisv11.rear_boxes: four of the five rear inner pickups sit on a face of their +/-40 mm boxes; the boxes bind the rear, so a wider box is the first change if V11's nodes allow it
requirements_for_chassisv11.rack: 81 mm of rack travel per steering-wheel turn (76.2 declared before); seeded searches under the same walls stalled over 120 deg of wheel on 76.2 and 80 mm racks
requirements_for_chassisv11.pushrod: pushrod on the upright on a bracket beside the lower ball joint (64 mm front, 47 mm rear), every link a two-force member; the bracket's bending is an item of the upright's design; its path past the declared upright, hub, rim, link and drivetrain envelopes is checked (S6.37) and the envelopes must be checked against the V11 CAD
requirements_for_chassisv11.tie_rod: front tie rod 3/4 x 0.083 in 4130: the cornering compliance wall needs it on the corrected cases
requirements_for_chassisv11.alignment: static camber: the corners are recorded at -2.5 deg front and -2.6 deg rear, which meet the declared optimum of -1.83 deg; published R25B results put the optimum near 0 deg (supplement S6.38), met at -0.74 deg front and -0.82 deg rear on the same gains, an alignment change with no pickup moved. Start at -0.7 deg front and -0.8 deg rear and set the static camber from the skidpad camber sweep between -0.5 and -2.75 deg (Table M10, row 11)
requirements_for_chassisv11.link_end_stiffness: the compliance walls were evaluated with rigid joints and tabs. With every link end (rod end or ball joint, tab, upright arm) in series along its link, the cornering toe wall holds above 11 kN/mm per end and the braking toe wall only above 494 kN/mm (toe in the 1.5 g stop 0.43 deg at 50 kN/mm), almost all of it from the lower-front leg (7.3 kN in the stop). Pull-test every pickup with its joint and tab (Table M10, row 9) before the frame is released; below that stiffness, re-run the front search with the measured end stiffness declared (scripts/review_checks.py, suspension/compliance_margin.py)
requirements_for_chassisv11.steering_upright_alternative_front_v11_f: the effort wall holds to a zero-slip pneumatic trail of 22.4 mm on the declared tire (8.1 N*m at the hand at the estimated trail). Alternative upright, pre-verified (scripts/steering_margin.py): spindle moved 2.0 mm forward relative to the kingpin axis, caster, kingpin and every pickup unchanged, mechanical trail 12.7 -> 10.7 mm, every wall and band held (wheel clearance +0.14 mm beyond the wall). Machine it if the skidpad steering-torque log (Table M10, row 18) fits a zero-slip trail above 22.4 mm; at 25.4 mm it gives 9.9 N*m on the declared tire and 9.6 at road mu 1.43. Do not change the steering ratio: the hairpin needs 118.9 of the 120 deg wheel-angle wall
